headline: Wagner's season-high 33 snaps Orlando's skid
dek: Franz Wagner scored 33 and Anthony Black 26. Orlando snapped a four-game losing streak.
three: 10 of 10 at the line, with 7 rebounds and 7 assists.
Up 5 at the half, and never behind after an 18–5 run in the second
Wagner and Black combined for 59 of 107.
Won it in the paint and on turnovers
Points in the paint 58–28; turnovers forced 21–14. Orlando scored 33 points off 21 Sacramento turnovers.
